name: fleet-steward
description: claude-fleet steward: /fleet-steward takes the steward role in a session that holds no issue and runs its own patrol loop — answers due questions by their suggestion, spawns a red base's fixer, lands a driverless batch, parks, files health issues — and draws the decision sheet / patrol / batches panes in that window only. Nobody holds it ⇒ none of that runs. Needs fleet-orchestrate. Not installed by default (EPIC #3111).
